ref_sources: Fisherman's Huts at Hadicurari: a row of small timber huts on the sand north of the high-rises, faded blue, yellow, white and green, thatch and metal roofs. Crescent kites sit in the sky on lines (the morning and late-day sport) and windsurf rigs stand on the sand; a line of yellow buoys marks the riding zone offshore. OSM Hadicurari Beach node 4632067907. The existing sail rack (hadicurari_fx) is left where it stands. No kite-brand marks.
